open_fronts.title: Deep tier on a 12 GB-class phone
open_fronts.question: Does the recommended deep configuration (35B mixture-of-experts + 512-token thinking budget) run on a 12 GB-class Android phone, at what latency and memory, and with the same judged quality as on the desktop?
open_fronts.why_it_matters: Every deep-tier number in the record is desktop only; the phone time is a projection from third-party public rates, and the bounty is about a phone.
open_fronts.what_would_change: If it runs with judged parity: the deep-tier rows in 'The deep tier' and 'A phone on a desk, and in a hand' gain a measured phone scope, the projection F-035 is replaced by a measurement, and 'Where it stands (live)' can describe the deep tier as a phone configuration. If it does not fit in memory, is too slow to use, or loses quality on the phone: the deep tier stays a desktop-only result, the phone standing remains the frozen 4B build (F-001, F-023), and the attempt is recorded as a negative result.
open_fronts.note: Dropped by author decision on 2026-10-21: no 35B deep mode is delivered for the bounty; the deep tier appears only as a roadmap with its desktop numbers. No deep-tier phone run exists as of 2026-10-24; F-035 stays a projection.

open_fronts.title: Expert-streaming engine on Android
open_fronts.question: Can the expert-streaming engine, judged equivalent to the desktop server on the 35B model, be built for Android and run within a phone's memory at a usable speed?
open_fronts.why_it_matters: On a desktop CPU it runs the 35B model in under 3 GiB of RAM; on a phone only an analytic speed projection exists, and the Android build needs memory and thinking-budget work that is not done.
open_fronts.what_would_change: If it builds and runs: OF-1 gains a low-memory path, and the analytic projection F-793 is replaced by a measured phone speed in 'A phone on a desk, and in a hand'. If it does not: the phone path for the deep tier rests on the other on-device engine (F-037), and the expert-streaming result stays a desktop-only finding (F-036).
open_fronts.note: The expert-streaming engine was cross-built for Android arm64 on 2026-10-19; phone speed and memory were never measured. Dropped with OF-1 when the deep tier left the delivery (2026-10-21).
